messages:
paul: Heads-up: I opened a short relnotes draft for the docs release (v0.11.0) at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1107. Need: 3 user-facing bullets, one-line migration note, Known Issues entry.
tara: I'll do bullets. Suggest: streaming perf improvements, smarter batching heuristics, and a tiny prefix-cache example.
izzy: Adding minimal SDK snippets (py/js) — will keep them to 1-3 lines. Example form: `client.generate('...', streaming=True)`. Also adding migration note about the streaming default flip.
paul: Known Issue: embeddings may 429 under sustained high-concurrency when Dedicated burst is active. Repro included: `wrk -t6 -c120 -d30s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`. Mitigation: client retries/backoff or route off the burst pool.
tara: I'll replace the expired gist in examples/prefix-cache.md with an inline repo sample. Keeping examples <=6 lines.
link-bot: Found broken anchor: guides/rollouts.md#canary -> should be #canary-deploy. Recommend patch before merge.
ci-bot: CI queued on PR#1107: link-check, snippet-lint, build. Results in ~6m.
izzy: Draft TL;DR for announcement: "v0.11.0 — improved streaming, smarter batching, and minor SDK tweaks; see migration notes."
paul: Assign reviewers @tara @izzy. If CI green and no objections, merge tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
